item.title: React 19.3: Adds a browser() API, Giving Client-Only Rendering a First-Class Name
item.description: React 19.3 was released on September 9, introducing several features including the react-dom browser() API. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Making React Context Cheap with React Compiler
item.description: Many of us have craved a context selector at some point, but React still doesn't have one. I benchmarked 5,000 radios to see whether React Compiler makes that matter less than we think. (2 sources: lobsters, reactstatus)

item.title: React Native Testing Library 14.1
item.description: 🦉 Simple and complete React Native testing utilities that encourage good testing practices. - Release v14.1.0 · callstack/react-native-testing-library (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: Ship your first agent in minutes with Trigger.dev
item.description: Trigger.dev is the open source platform for durable AI agents and workflows in TypeScript. Long-running tasks with retries, queues, and LLM observability. (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: six months of building with v3
item.description: Six months on Remix v3 turned into 88 packages, because I kept copying the framework's own design decisions. (1 source: reactstatus)
